title: EpochChangedFrame
description: Notification broadcast when a topic's epoch has changed (e.g. after a Redis restart or publisher restart). Invalidates all previous sequence numbers for this topic and forces connected clients to re-snapshot.

type.description: Server control frame discriminator. A text frame carrying `type` is a control frame; a text frame without it is a stream envelope.

topic.description: The topic whose epoch has changed.

previous_epoch.description: The previous epoch value, if known.
